_about: Every visitor-facing string of the Prepare hub (/prepare), filled by src/lib/site/prepare-hub.ts. The H1 is the section's question (PREPARE_QUESTION in src/lib/site/routes.ts); the group names and lines come from data/lab/readiness/readiness.json, and every count is computed. The hub shows no source's words. British English, no dashes, no score language.

copy.hubLede: Answer one question at a time to see what published guidance asks of you, and what to take first.
copy.hubLedeShort: Where to begin on post-quantum cryptography, with tools the Atlas builds from published sources.
copy.standingNote: Every date in the Readiness Check is a target set by guidance or a recommendation. None is a legal deadline.
copy.groupsIntro: {groups} groups of questions, to take in any order. The counts are for {guides}, the guides the Check starts with.
copy.otherExposure: How long your data must stay secret: the Exposure Clock
